title: BMMS: Policy-Conditioned Measurement of Behavioral Compliance in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.09147v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Behavioral evaluation of language models fixes its dimensions in advance: hallucination, sycophancy, toxicity, over-refusal. An operator in a regulated industry needs a different question answered: does a system do what a particular rulebook requires? We introduce the Behavioral Misalignment Metric Suite (BMMS), which measures policy-conditioned misalignment by taking a policy corpus as an argument and returning a compliance profile over it, for any published policy and any system that answers in natural language. The Compliance Attainment Score (CAS) measures severity-weighted attainment over the obligations that bind the system, and the Compliance Robustness Margin (CRM) the share of that attainment surviving graded adversarial pressure; Behavioral Invariance (BIV) and the Behavioral Disposition Index (BDI) are specified and released with the suite. translated_title: BMMS：语言模型中策略条件化的行为合规性度量
translated_abstract: 语言模型的行为评估预先固定了其评估维度：幻觉、谄媚、毒性、过度拒绝。而受监管行业的运营者需要回答的是一个不同的问题：系统是否做到了某本特定规则手册所要求的事项？我们提出了行为失准度量套件，它以政策语料库作为输入参数，并返回针对该语料库的合规画像，从而度量策略条件化的失准程度，适用于任何已发布的政策和任何以自然语言作答的系统。其中，合规达成度分数衡量系统在其所受约束义务上的严重度加权达成程度；合规稳健性裕度衡量该达成度在分级对抗压力下仍能保留的比例；行为不变性（BIV）和行为倾向指数（BDI）也随套件一同被定义并发布。评估维度只有通过一个公开发布的准入测试（其约束性判据……）才能进入评估体系。
tldr: BMMS是一个以任意已发布政策语料库为输入、返回合规画像的策略条件化度量套件，通过合规达成度分数（CAS）和合规稳健性裕度（CRM）等指标，首次实现了对语言模型行为合规性及其对抗稳健性的量化评估。
en_tdlr: BMMS is a policy-conditioned metric suite that takes any published policy corpus as input and returns a compliance profile, enabling quantitative measurement of language models' behavioral compliance through severity-weighted attainment (CAS) and adversarial robustness (CRM) metrics.
